user.title: Hubitat Maker API
user.description: Paste any URL from the Maker API app in Hubitat (for example the "Get All Devices" link). If the URL already contains `access_token=...`, the token field can stay empty. The IR blaster must be selected in the Maker API app.

device.title: IR blaster
device.description: Choose the device that uses the "Tuya Zigbee IR Remote Control" driver.

remote.title: Remote control
remote.description: Choose the remote layout that is sent through **{device}**. Own layouts (JSON + SVG) go into the folder `ir_remote_http_bridge` in the Home Assistant config directory.

data_description.name: Shown as device name and card title. Empty: name of the layout.

data.device_id: Hubitat device ID of the IR blaster

error.invalid_url: This is not a Maker API URL (expected .../apps/api/<number>).
error.token_required: Enter the access token or paste a URL that contains it.
error.invalid_auth: The Maker API rejected the access token.
error.no_devices: The Maker API app does not expose any devices. Select the IR blaster in the Maker API app first.
error.unknown_device: The Maker API app does not expose a device with this ID.

data_description.send_mode: "By name" lets the Hubitat driver look up the code it stored while learning. "Raw code" sends the code stored in Home Assistant.
data_description.learn_timeout: How long to wait for a key press on the original remote.

options.name: By name (code stored in the Hubitat driver)
